summary: The library emphasizes the importance of E-Rate for its operations and services, arguing against any sunset or limit on the program. The foundational success of the E-Rate program relies on robust support for both Category 1 transport lines and Category 2 internal network infrastructure. Narrowing the scope of eligible services or scaling back support for core routing, switching, and wireless access points would cause immediate infrastructure issues for libraries. The comment highlights the potential negative impacts of reducing or eliminating E-Rate funding on a local library system, emphasizing the importance of preserving current screen-time limits for educational purposes and the broader operational implications of such a change. The text argues against sunsetting or limiting the E-Rate program, emphasizing the importance of preserving its core components and maintaining eligibility for various services. It highlights the costs and benefits of preserving the program and calls for thoughtful improvements rather than cuts.
